sources.game: Read from the installed game files for this build: Data\Game2.dcb records, Data\Localization\english\global.ini, and the solar-system object containers (.socpak) in Data.p4k.

sources.seen: Seen in the game's own output (Game.log lines or the in-game screen); the entry says what.
sources.user: Told to an earlier session by the player.

_meta.lookup: Keys are vehicle classes as the log prints them: the <CLASS> in '<CLASS>_<id>' (match without regard to case if the exact key is missing). `cargo_scu` counts the cargo grid in 1.25 m cells; `cargo_how` says where it came from (see `cargo_how_means`); null when the records do not settle it. `variant` marks NPC, template and tutorial classes. `fleet` (from ships.hand.json, src user) is the player's fleet: `job` is the one activity view a ship stands for (mining, salvage, cargo, combat) or null for a ship with no single job.

cargo_how_means.loadout: the cargo grids in the ship's default loadout
cargo_how_means.named grid: no grid in the default loadout; the one cargo-grid record named for the ship class (<class>_CargoGrid...) [verify: tied by name, not by a reference the client records hold]
cargo_how_means.several named grids: no grid in the default loadout and several cargo-grid records named for the ship class; which of them the ship carries is not in the readable records
